correctness.rationale: The displayed pair of quadrics has squarefree degree-five pencil discriminant over F5, hence is a smooth quartic del Pezzo complete intersection. Exact enumeration of 781 projective points and all RREF subspaces of codimensions 1..4 gives the four complete histograms. The independent published 5x31 matrix yields all 31 points and 640 coplanar quadruples by finite rank tests; incidence identities reproduce the plane histogram. The code hierarchy follows by maximizing zero supports. Both standalone verifiers passed.

value.rationale: The explicitly published rank-one quartic del Pezzo code is highlighted in [1] as attaining best-known [31,5,21] parameters. The new result computes its natural full linear-section arithmetic profile, exact number 640 of four-point rational plane sections and every generalized Hamming weight (21,27,29,30,31), which measure support under multi-dimensional linear systems. These quantities are not determined by the known code parameters, provide exact reproducible invariants useful in code/finite-geometry comparisons, and are a complete classification rather than an arbitrary unmotivated subslice.
